core_principle.principle: CONDITIONAL CONCENTRATION WITHOUT MARGINAL / GLOBAL MODE COLLAPSE
core_principle.description: Similar prediction-time observable cases must concentrate probability over a small, repeatable set of plausible cash-out locations (achieving high conditional learnability), while the overall dataset must remain diverse across all 60 operational clusters and 11 districts without collapsing onto city-wide hubs.
core_principle.formal_representation: Strong P(cluster | behavioral_context, realized_district) alongside balanced marginal P(cluster) across all clusters.

seed_universe.unconsumed_protection: Seeds 38184, 38185, 38186 are strictly UNGENERATED in this design phase. Previous seeds 36185, 36186, 37185, 37186 remain ungenerated and retired.

dataset_specifications.chronological_ordering: Strict chronological ordering by event_timestamp with no pre-split shuffling

two_stage_hierarchical_architecture.flow: PRE-EVENT OBSERVABLES -> Stage 1 Evidence-Aggregated District Scoring -> REALIZED CASHOUT DISTRICT -> Stage 2 District-Local Portfolio Cluster Selection -> REALIZED CASHOUT CLUSTER

hard_geographic_invariant.enforcement: Stage 2 candidate clusters are strictly restricted to the subset belonging to the sampled realized district.

normalization_contract.rules: District distribution sum == 1.0 within 1e-9; Cluster distribution sum == 1.0 within 1e-9; Sampling must execute on full-precision float64 vectors before any serialization formatting.
normalization_contract.serialization_policy: Serialized 4-decimal JSON strings remain reporting/diagnostic fields only and do not alter generation probabilities.

stage_1_district_transition_redesign.objective: Derive P(cashout_district | observables) across 11 revenue districts with high cross-district route coherence
stage_1_district_transition_redesign.cross_district_headroom_target: Design for cross-district Top-1 accuracy >= 37.0% (to comfortably exceed the 30.0% hard gate and support the >= 45.0% overall district gate)

channel_e_leakage_safe_history: historical_corridor_recurrence_prior (computed strictly on prior chronological events)

route_coherence_mechanism.description: Laundering hops represent a directed spatial trajectory: victim origin -> intermediate mule district -> downstream cluster -> terminal mule district. District cash-out weights are shaped by the vector of downstream momentum rather than independent disconnected district picks.
route_coherence_mechanism.evidence_consensus_score: Composite metric reflecting the agreement between dominant account, terminal mule, and downstream money-flow trajectory. High consensus sharpens preferred district probability (0.45 - 0.65), while conflicting evidence increases entropy across adjacent plausible districts (0.20 - 0.35).

stage_2_cluster_selection_redesign.objective: Derive P(cashout_cluster | realized_district, archetype, observables) within realized district without global mode collapse

district_local_functional_role_system.decentralization_principle: No single city-wide cluster receives a global commercial or transport bonus. Functional roles are partitioned locally within each revenue district. Cluster 7 (Connaught Place) only competes as a commercial hub when NEW_DELHI is the realized district.

sub_prototype_portfolio_mapping.role_mapping_policy: Each of the 54 sub-prototypes maps to 2-3 functional cluster roles, NEVER to a single fixed cluster ID.
sub_prototype_portfolio_mapping.district_local_portfolio_size: Within each realized district, each sub-prototype context resolves to a portfolio of 3 to 6 candidate clusters categorized into Primary, Secondary, and Long-Tail candidates.

fraud_cluster_decoupling.principle: Fraud types influence functional role preferences, NOT specific cluster IDs.
fraud_cluster_decoupling.example: Marketplace fraud prefers MIXED_RETAIL_CORRIDOR and COMMERCIAL_HUB_LOCAL roles across ALL 11 districts, distributing marketplace fraud cases across 20+ distinct retail clusters across the city, strictly preventing Seelampur or any single cluster from exceeding 15.0% fraud share.

global_popularity_control.rule: Global historical popularity prior weight is strictly capped at 12% of total intra-district weight, preventing positive feedback loops and mode collapse.

entropy_monitoring: H(cluster | recurring_signature) in [1.5, 3.2] bits (meaningful conditional focus without determinism)
H(cluster | fraud_type) >= 4.5 bits (strong multi-cluster fraud dispersal)

anti_gaming_rules.rule_1: No post-generation cluster quota enforcement or row deletion.
anti_gaming_rules.rule_2: No target reassignment after seeing validation metrics.
anti_gaming_rules.rule_4: All distributions must arise organically from the frozen probabilistic mathematical formulation.
